notes_for_human: ZERO tier-1 quotes were captured. www.mckinsey.com is fully unreachable from this environment: TLS completes, then the origin returns no body, across two tools, both HTTP versions, and timeouts from 20s to 60s. The one McKinsey host that did respond, jobs.mckinsey.com, serves a JS-rendered ATS shell with no posting text. Everything in this record is therefore 'unverified', never 'stated' and never 'silent'. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION on cooling_off: I did not mark it silent, because silent is a claim about the public record that requires actually reading the page. I could not read it. Search engines surfaced only prep vendors (MConsultingPrep, HackingTheCaseInterview, StrategyCase, CaseBasix, MyConsultingOffer, Leland, RoadToOffer) and forums (PrepLounge) asserting 12-18 or 18-24 month bans and a 12-month Solve score-reuse window; these are excluded by the sourcing rules and were deliberately NOT imported, including as tier 3. The folklore number remains unverified against McKinsey's own words. Search snippets also floated specific graduation windows (Dec 2026-Aug 2027 for Summer BA; Dec 2027-Aug 2028 for SSBA) and a '3.8+ GPA preferred' claim; the GPA claim in particular reads as vendor invention and none of it is firm-sourced, so none was recorded. One URL correction worth carrying forward: the Sophomore Summer Business Analyst page lives at the legacy slug /careers/students/sophomore-diversity-leaders-internship. RETRY PATH: this needs a browser session with real JS rendering and a residential-looking client, or a manual capture. Recommend re-running from a different network before this firm's rows are published.
